summary: The window is dominated by physics-integrated modeling rather than new detector results: an effective bulk-viscous description of early quark chemical equilibration, a quantum-localization correction to transport femtoscopy, and an active-learning basis-selection workflow with variational control. A new HENP ML review consolidates credible transfer themes around constrained inference, differentiable solvers, and uncertainty validation.
strongest_paper_summary: Effective macroscopic description of early-stage chemical equilibration with final-state tests across Pb+Pb, O+O, and p+Pb.

papers.title: An effective macroscopic description of early-stage chemical equilibration in high-energy heavy-ion collisions
papers.short_authors: Anar Akbarov, Hendrik Roch, Chun Shen
papers.abstract: The early stage evolves from a gluon-rich to a chemically equilibrated QGP. An effective hydrodynamic bulk-viscous pressure captures quark chemical equilibration and conformal-symmetry breaking, with tests in Pb+Pb, O+O, and p+Pb.

papers.title: Quantum Localization Limit of Transport-Based Femtoscopy
papers.short_authors: Jiaxing Zhao, Joerg Aichelin, Elena Bratkovskaya
papers.abstract: Minimum-uncertainty Gaussian phase-space emitters replace classical transport points; finite localization changes proton-pair sources and momentum correlations in 7 TeV pp PHSD simulations.

papers.title: Active-learning construction of hyperspherical-harmonics spaces for A = 3
papers.short_authors: Elena Filandri, Andrea Di Luca, Laura Elisa Marcucci, Michele Viviani
papers.abstract: A Gaussian-process surrogate and cost-aware acquisition select hyperspherical-harmonics extensions; explicit variational solves reproduce K=60 benchmarks within 4 keV while leaving over 60% of the space unbuilt.

papers.title: Machine Learning Meets High-Energy Nuclear Physics: From Pattern Recognition to Physics-Integrated Discovery
papers.short_authors: Xun Chen, Weiyao Ke, Yu-Gang Ma, Long-Gang Pang, Kai Zhou
papers.abstract: A mini-review surveys physics-integrated ML across heavy-ion, neutron-star, lattice, and QCD workflows, emphasizing constraints, uncertainty quantification, and validation.

papers.title: Physics-informed interpretable forms for dipole resonances and quantities relevant for astrophysics
papers.short_authors: Gourab Banerjee, Jhilam Sadhukhan, Debasish Mondal, B. K. Agrawal, Chandrani Sen, S. Mukhopadhyay
papers.abstract: Bayesian inference extracts dipole-resonance systematics with explicit structural effects and constrains symmetry-energy coefficients and neutron-skin correlations.

cautions.title: A Density Functional for Quark Matter with Screened Confinement Interactions
cautions.abstract: A density functional is derived for quark matter with screened linear confinement and an interaction energy density proportional to n^(2/3).

cautions.title: Minimal-Length Corrections to Hyperon Polarization in Rotating Quark Gluon Plasma
cautions.abstract: A generalized-uncertainty-principle correction to hyperon polarization cancels locally and survives only through freeze-out covariance; no exclusion limit is inferred because the linear expansion is outside its reliable domain at current precision.
